name: Drutopia Event
description: Config-only Features module that ships an Event content type with a date-range field and event-type taxonomy, its fields, form/view displays, a Search API-backed listing view with topic and type facets, pathauto patterns, an event_type vocabulary, and role permission grants; part of the Drutopia distribution.
project_description: Drutopia Event is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia', required: true) of the Drutopia distribution. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP, routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports an Event node type, its fields (event date as a datetime range, event type taxonomy reference, summary, body, paragraph body, media image, a deprecated legacy image, tags, topics, meta tags), a form display and seven view displays, a Search API-backed listing view (an /events page, an 'Upcoming events' block, and a master display) with topic and event-type facets, two pathauto URL patterns, an 'event_type' taxonomy vocabulary, an 'Add event' action link, a block visibility group, and config actions that grant event permissions to the Drutopia contributor/editor/manager roles. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the full Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core, drutopia_seo plus ds, facets, field_group, paragraphs, pathauto, metatag, search_api, media, entity_reference_revisions, focal_point, block_visibility_groups and more) and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
